children: Plains All American Pipeline entered into a Subordinated Indenture and related supplemental indentures to complete a $1.5 billion public offering of junior subordinated notes. The deal covers $700 million of 6.750% Series A Notes and $800 million of 7.000% Series B Notes, both maturing on December 15, 2056, with semiannual interest and future rate reset features. The notes are unsecured and junior to senior debt, and are callable as outlined in the indenture. Proceeds support long-term financing and capital structure flexibility.
: Subordinated indenture and supplemental indentures for $1.5 billion junior subordinated notes due 2056
: U.S. Bank Trust Company, as trustee
: Raise long-term capital at fixed rates
